definition: means the amount charged by a Hospital towards ICU expenses which shall include the expenses for ICU bed, general medical support services provided to any ICU patient including monitoring devices, critical care nursing and intensivist charges.
plain: What a hospital charges for an intensive-care bed, including the general medical support services provided there.
whyItMatters: Some policies cap ICU separately from the ordinary room, and ICU is where bills escalate fastest. A plan with no ordinary room-rent limit but a capped ICU has a limit exactly where you are least able to shop around.
